caption: The drawing features two metal objects positioned side by side near the center-upper portion of the paper, both rendered in shades of gold, brown, and hints of orange. The object on the left has a vertical orientation with an ornate, symmetrical top resembling a decorative finial, broadening slightly near the top before tapering into a straight lower section. The object on the right is shown in profile, displaying a curved structure with a hook-like element and a thin, straight protruding pin or rod. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or detailing. In the lower right corner, the name "Humagalli" is signed in small, capitalized letters.
title: Pin
